scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev --prefix Backend
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev --prefix Frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --prefix Frontend
scripts.verify: npm run seed:full --prefix Backend && npm run build --prefix Frontend
